notes.title: Demo update v0.0.2.0 patch notes
notes.notes:
DEMO UPDATE -  v0.0.2.0 - Patch Notes

 Fixed bug where shield couldn't be used if player died with shield on
 Modified player collision shape to be somewhat smaller
 Fixed a bug in level-select menu
 Waifu boss now reverts to fully clothed if player loses on their level
 Changed hidden leaderboard name
 Implemented voice acting for Frederick, the pervy old copilot
 Added pre-level scenes with Frederick
 other small behind the scenes fixes/efficiency updates

notes.title: Demo Update - v0.0.1.6 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
DEMO VERSION 0.0.1.6 PATCH NOTES

 Fixed display problem with leaderboard cutting off last line
 Moved "Quit Game" button on title screen to the bottom of the list
 Added waifu names to gallery and pre-level scenes
 Fixed level name display error in gallery
 Added "back" button to exit credits, no longer forcing player to wait for them to finish
 Created leaderboard to track special hidden event in gallery
 Fixed leaderboard scrolling issue
 Other small fixes

notes.title: Demo Update - v0.0.1.4
notes.notes:
Waifu Force DEMO v0.0.1.4 is live. 

Included updates:

  added labels to powerup boxes to make it more clear for users how to use them
  music/sfx stay down after end-of-level scene pops up
  Control settings updated as follows, controller fully disabled unless user enables it in options.If user enables controller, KB game controls are disabled, but user can still navigate the menus with the KB
  GALLERY is now enabled!
  Gallery content adjusts with each level user completes
  Gallery content adjusts if NSFW mode is enabled
  Secret easter egg hidden in gallery
